title: Ensure 'Application: Control Event Log behavior when the log file reaches its maximum size' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Event Log Service\Application\Control Event Log behavior when the log file reaches its maximum size to 'Disabled'
reason: If new events are not recorded it may be difficult or impossible to determine the root cause of system problems.

title: Ensure 'Application: Specify the maximum log file size (KB)' is set to 'Enabled: 32,768 or greater'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Event Log Service\Application\Specify the maximum log file size (KB) to 'Enabled: 32,768 or greater'
reason: If events are not recorded it may be difficult or impossible to determine the root cause of system problems or the unauthorized activities of threat actors.

title: Ensure 'Security: Specify the maximum log file size (KB)' is set to 'Enabled: 196,608 or greater'
